local_context: The Fort - South Lincoln / Fort Brands.
method: Official Fort Brands directory reviewed as a current-product directory. Zero-product historical entries and non-fashion tack/decor/gift suppliers were excluded. Fashion-relevant apparel, western/workwear, footwear and headwear labels with current product presence were retained.
sizing_policy: Verified product/brand sizing first; otherwise low-confidence generic S/M/L/XL for compatible apparel.
completeness_note: Current dated inventory snapshot. Product counts and active brands can change.
